description: Products to offer for a post's Shop the post sheet, best first: links whose discount code or address (or short link) is in the caption, links to a site the caption names, links whose name the caption uses ("pour-over" for a pour over kettle), then the products on your last post with products. Pass post_id (from shop_posts_list) or the caption of a post being written; with neither, only your last post's products. Suggestions only: nothing is attached until the person picks some and you call post_links_set (or post_create with shop_link_ids).

caption.description: The caption being written (instead of post_id, or to try a new one on it)

link_ids.description: Products already picked, left out of the suggestions

post_id.description: A post_id from shop_posts_list: its caption, leaving out the products it already has

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: post_links_suggest
title: Suggest products for a post
